announcement: # Senior DevOps Engineer - Webfleet, Leipzig URL: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/job_display/296568/Senior_DevOps_Engineer_Webfleet_Leipzig_Germany Senior DevOps Engineer - Webfleet, Leipzig #### As part of the team, you will: - Design, improve, and maintain cloud-based infrastructure and platform services; - Work with AWS and Kubernetes to operate scalable and reliable services; - Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines; - Automate infrastructure and operational processes using tools such as Terraform; - Use Java and/or Groovy to develop, maintain, and improve automation, tooling, pipelines, and platform-related services; - Collaborate with development teams, architects, product owners, and system engineers to support reliable delivery of new features; - Improve monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational visibility using tools such as Grafana; - Support stability, performance, quality assurance, incident prevention, and continuous improvement; - Help improve deployment processes, release automation, and service operations; - Identify, prevent, and resolve potential security and operational risks; - Contribute to code reviews, infrastructure reviews, and technical discussions. ### Who are you? There is no single path to becoming part of Webfleet. #### However, to be successful in this role, we imagine you bring the following: - Solid experience as a DevOps engineer, platform engineer, cloud engineer, or similar role; - Strong Java and/or Groovy development skills; - Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes; - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins; - Experience with container technologies such as Docker; - Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform; - A good understanding of cloud infrastructure, service operations, automation, monitoring, and reliability; - An interest in working closely with software engineers, architects, component owners, and system engineers; - Strong communication skills, an analytical mindset, and a goal-oriented, quality-focused approach; - Knowledge of PostgreSQL would be a plus; - A willingness to learn and adopt new technologies as needed by the team; - Fluency in English.
